address: Rathfinny Wine Estate, Alfriston, BN26 5TU, United Kingdom
bio: The upper floor of the Rathfinny Wine Estate houses this smart, well-run restaurant that boasts lovely views over the vines. Drink it all in as you sip on one of the vineyard's own sparkling wines, accompanied by colourful sharing plates. Seasonal Sussex produce is the bedrock of the cooking, fashioned into dishes that prove to be both fresh and flavoursome. They also have bedrooms in The Flint Barns, a nearby farmhouse, while vineyard tours, tastings and special 'wine dinners' are also available....
